seoDescription: Shop genuine fast car chargers in Nepal: USB-C PD and Quick Charge chargers for phones, tablets and laptops on the road.
seoContent:
## Buy car chargers in Nepal

Long drives, highway trips and city traffic all drain your phone, especially when you use maps. A fast car charger tops it up quickly through the car's 12V socket, so you arrive with plenty of battery.

## How to choose a car charger

- Fast charging: USB-C Power Delivery for iPhones and most phones, plus Quick Charge for many Android phones
- Power: 20 to 30 W per port charges phones quickly; 45 W or more can charge a tablet or some laptops
- Ports: dual-port chargers charge two devices at once; check the power when both are in use
- Safety: protection against overheating, over-current and voltage spikes
- Size: flush-fit chargers sit neatly in the socket

Use a good cable to get full speed. All car chargers we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Will a car charger drain my car battery?
faqs.answer: In most cars the 12V socket turns off with the ignition, so it does not drain the battery. If your car's socket stays on, unplug the charger when the car is parked for long.

faqs.question: Can a car charger fast-charge an iPhone?
faqs.answer: Yes, with a USB-C Power Delivery car charger of 20 W or more and a USB-C to Lightning or USB-C cable.

faqs.question: Can I charge a laptop in the car?
faqs.answer: If your laptop charges over USB-C, a high-power USB-C PD car charger can charge it. Check that the charger provides enough watts for your laptop.

seoDescription: Buy car phone holders in Nepal: magnetic, vent, dashboard and windscreen mounts for safe, hands-free navigation.
seoContent:
## Buy phone holders in Nepal

Holding your phone while driving is dangerous and distracting. A good phone holder keeps the screen at eye level for navigation and calls, and stays steady on rough roads.

## Types of phone holders

- Air vent mounts: clip onto the vent, easy to install and remove
- Dashboard and windscreen mounts: suction cups or adhesive for a stable, adjustable position
- Magnetic mounts: snap the phone on and off with one hand; MagSafe-compatible versions suit iPhones
- Wireless charging mounts: charge while you navigate

## What to check

- That it holds your phone size securely, including with a case
- Grip strength for bumpy roads
- Whether it blocks your view or air vents

All phone holders we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Are magnetic phone holders safe for my phone?
faqs.answer: Yes. Magnets used in phone holders do not damage modern phones. Some cases may need a thin metal plate unless the phone and case support MagSafe.

faqs.question: Will a phone holder stay firm on rough roads?
faqs.answer: Dashboard and windscreen mounts with strong suction or adhesive, and holders with spring-loaded clamps, stay the most stable on bumpy roads.

faqs.question: Will the holder fit my phone with a case?
faqs.answer: Check the supported phone width on the product page. Most holders fit phones with standard cases.

seoDescription: Shop dash cams in Nepal: front and rear car cameras with loop recording, night vision and G-sensor for accident evidence.
seoContent:
## Buy dash cams in Nepal

A dash cam records the road while you drive, giving you clear video evidence if there is an accident, a dispute or an insurance claim. It runs automatically every time you start the car.

## Features to look for

- Video quality: 1080p at minimum, 2K or 4K to read number plates more clearly
- Night vision: a good sensor and wide aperture for night and tunnel driving
- Front and rear: dual-channel cameras also record behind the car
- Loop recording: automatically records over the oldest footage when the card is full
- G-sensor: locks footage when it detects a collision so it is not overwritten
- Parking mode: records incidents while parked (may need a hardwire kit)
- Wi-Fi and app to download clips to your phone

## Use the right memory card

Dash cams record constantly, so use a high endurance microSD card. All dash cams we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: What memory card should I use in a dash cam?
faqs.answer: Use a high endurance microSD card designed for constant recording, in a capacity the dash cam supports. Normal cards can wear out quickly.

faqs.question: Does a dash cam record when the car is off?
faqs.answer: Only if it has a parking mode and is connected to constant power, usually through a hardwire kit or a battery pack.

faqs.question: How is a dash cam powered?
faqs.answer: Most plug into the car's 12V socket or a USB port. A hardwire kit gives a cleaner install and enables parking mode.

faqs.question: What gear do I need to start vlogging?

faqs.question: Which camera is best for trekking?

faqs.question: Are your cameras and drones genuine?

seoDescription: Shop genuine digital cameras in Nepal for photography and video: mirrorless, compact and vlogging cameras from trusted brands.
seoContent:
## Buy cameras in Nepal

Phone cameras are excellent, but a dedicated camera still gives you better image quality in low light, real optical zoom, natural background blur and interchangeable lenses. It is the next step for photographers, vloggers and content creators.

## Types of cameras

- Mirrorless cameras: compact bodies with interchangeable lenses and excellent photo and video quality
- Compact cameras: pocketable with a built-in zoom lens
- Vlogging cameras: flip-out screens, good microphones and stabilisation for filming yourself
- Instant cameras: print photos straight away

## What to consider

- Sensor size: larger sensors handle low light better and give more background blur
- Video specs: 4K, frame rates and stabilisation for video work
- Lenses: the lens system and available lenses for your style
- Battery life and weather sealing for travel and trekking

All cameras we sell are genuine, with what is in the box listed on each product page.

faqs.question: Is a camera better than a phone for photos?
faqs.answer: For low light, zoom, sports, wildlife and portraits with natural background blur, a dedicated camera with a larger sensor and good lens clearly beats a phone.

faqs.question: What is a mirrorless camera?
faqs.answer: A mirrorless camera has no internal mirror like a traditional DSLR, so it is smaller and lighter while still using interchangeable lenses.

faqs.question: Which camera is good for YouTube?
faqs.answer: Look for a flip-out screen, reliable autofocus, 4K video, a microphone input and good stabilisation.

seoDescription: Buy genuine action cameras in Nepal: waterproof 4K cameras with stabilisation for treks, rides, rafting and vlogging.
seoContent:
## Buy action cameras in Nepal

Action cameras are built for adventure: trekking to base camp, paragliding over Pokhara, rafting, mountain biking and motorbike rides. They are small, tough, waterproof and record smooth 4K video even on rough terrain.

## What to look for

- Stabilisation: electronic stabilisation keeps footage smooth without a gimbal
- Resolution and frame rate: 4K for detail, high frame rates for slow motion
- Waterproofing: many models are waterproof without a case to several metres
- Battery: removable batteries let you carry spares for long days in the cold
- Mounts: helmet, chest, handlebar and selfie stick mounts for different shots
- Screens: a front screen helps frame selfie and vlog shots

## Tips for the mountains

Cold weather drains batteries quickly, so keep spares warm in an inside pocket, and use a fast, genuine microSD card for 4K recording. All action cameras we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Are action cameras waterproof?
faqs.answer: Many models are waterproof to around 10 metres without a case, and a dive housing allows deeper use. Check the rating on the product page.

faqs.question: Which memory card should I use?
faqs.answer: Use a genuine microSD card rated U3 or V30 or higher for 4K recording. Slower cards can stop recording mid-clip.

faqs.question: How long does the battery last on a trek?
faqs.answer: Typically around one to two hours of continuous recording, less in cold conditions. Carry spare batteries and a power bank on long treks.

seoDescription: Shop genuine drones in Nepal for aerial photography and video, with 4K cameras, GPS and obstacle sensing.
seoContent:
## Buy drones in Nepal

Drones open up views of Nepal's mountains, valleys, lakes and cities that are impossible from the ground. Modern camera drones are easy to fly, hold their position with GPS and capture stunning 4K photos and video.

## How to choose a drone

- Camera: 4K video and a larger sensor for better detail and low-light performance
- Gimbal: a 3-axis gimbal keeps footage smooth and level
- Flight time: look at minutes per battery, and consider a kit with spare batteries
- Safety features: GPS return-to-home and obstacle sensing reduce the risk of crashes
- Weight: lighter drones are easier to carry on treks and may face fewer restrictions in many countries
- Range and transmission: a stable video link matters in hilly terrain

## Flying drones in Nepal

Drone flying in Nepal is regulated. You may need permission from the relevant authorities, and flying near airports, government buildings, heritage sites and protected areas is restricted. Check the current rules before you fly. All drones we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Do I need permission to fly a drone in Nepal?
faqs.answer: Often, yes. Drone use in Nepal is regulated and permission may be required depending on where and why you fly. Flying near airports, heritage sites and protected areas is restricted. Check the latest rules with the authorities before flying.

faqs.question: How long can a drone fly?
faqs.answer: Most camera drones fly for roughly 20 to 45 minutes per battery depending on the model, wind and altitude. Cold and high altitude reduce flight time.

faqs.question: Are drones hard to fly for beginners?
faqs.answer: Modern GPS drones are very beginner-friendly, with automatic take-off, landing, return-to-home and obstacle sensing. Practise in an open area first.

seoDescription: Buy genuine phone and camera gimbals in Nepal for smooth, cinematic video, vlogs and tracking shots.
seoContent:
## Buy gimbals in Nepal

A gimbal uses motors to keep your phone or camera perfectly steady while you walk, run or pan, turning shaky clips into smooth, cinematic footage. It is one of the best upgrades for vloggers and content creators.

## Phone or camera gimbal?

- Phone gimbals: light, foldable and affordable, with app features such as face tracking and timelapses
- Camera gimbals: stronger motors for mirrorless cameras and lenses; check the payload rating

## What to look for

- Payload: the maximum weight it can balance, including your phone case or lens
- Battery life for a full day of shooting
- Tracking: automatic face and object tracking
- Built-in tripod and extension rod for selfies and group shots
- Foldable design for travel

All gimbals we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Do I need a gimbal if my phone has stabilisation?
faqs.answer: Phone stabilisation helps, but a gimbal gives much smoother movement for walking shots, pans and tracking, and adds features like subject tracking.

faqs.question: Will a gimbal hold my phone with a case?
faqs.answer: Usually yes, if the total weight and width are within the gimbal's limits. Very heavy cases may need to be removed for proper balance.

faqs.question: How do I balance a camera gimbal?
faqs.answer: Mount the camera with its final lens and accessories, then adjust each axis until the camera stays level on its own. The product's manual and app guide you through it.

seoDescription: Shop genuine microphones in Nepal: wireless lavalier, USB and on-camera mics for vlogging, podcasts, streaming and classes.
seoContent:
## Buy microphones in Nepal

Viewers forgive average video but not poor sound. A dedicated microphone makes vlogs, interviews, podcasts, streams and online classes much clearer and more professional.

## Types of microphones

- Wireless lavalier mics: clip-on transmitters for vlogs and interviews, with USB-C, Lightning or camera receivers
- USB microphones: plug into a computer for podcasts, streaming, voice-overs and meetings
- On-camera shotgun mics: mount on a camera and capture the sound in front of you
- Wired lavalier mics: an affordable option for phones and cameras

## What to look for

- Connection to your device (USB-C, Lightning, 3.5 mm or USB)
- Noise reduction for busy streets and windy locations
- Wind muffs for outdoor recording
- Range and battery life for wireless kits

All microphones we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Which microphone is best for phone vlogging?
faqs.answer: A wireless clip-on microphone with a receiver for your phone's port (USB-C or Lightning) is the most popular choice. It keeps your voice clear even when you are away from the phone.

faqs.question: Is a USB microphone good for podcasts and streaming?
faqs.answer: Yes. USB microphones plug straight into a computer, need no extra equipment, and sound far better than a laptop's built-in mic.

faqs.question: Do I need a wind muff outdoors?
faqs.answer: Yes. Even light wind causes loud rumbling on a microphone. A furry wind muff greatly reduces it.

seoDescription: Buy tripods in Nepal for phones and cameras: travel tripods, selfie stick tripods and desktop stands for photos and video.
seoContent:
## Buy tripods in Nepal

A tripod keeps your shots sharp and steady for low-light photos, long exposures, timelapses, group shots and videos where you are in the frame. It is a small investment that improves every kind of photography.

## Types of tripods

- Selfie stick tripods: extend for selfies, open into a tripod, often with a Bluetooth remote
- Travel tripods: compact and light for treks and travel, strong enough for cameras
- Full-size tripods: tall, very stable and good for professional work
- Desktop and flexible tripods: for video calls, vlogging at a desk and creative angles

## What to look for

- Maximum height and folded length
- Load capacity for your camera and lens
- Head type: ball head for photography, fluid head for smooth video pans
- A phone holder and Bluetooth remote for phone users

All tripods we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Can I use a camera tripod with my phone?
faqs.answer: Yes, with a phone holder that screws onto the standard tripod thread. Many tripods include one.

faqs.question: What tripod should I take trekking?
faqs.answer: A light travel tripod made of aluminium or carbon fibre with a compact folded length is easiest to carry, while still steady enough for mountain landscapes and night shots.

faqs.question: What does load capacity mean?
faqs.answer: It is the maximum weight the tripod can hold securely. Choose one rated above the weight of your camera, lens and accessories combined.

seoDescription: Shop genuine power backup in Nepal: UPS units, portable power stations and surge-protected extension boards for power cuts.
seoContent:
## Buy UPS and power backup in Nepal

Power cuts and voltage fluctuations are still part of life in many parts of Nepal. The right power gear keeps your internet, computer and essential devices running, and protects electronics from damaging surges.

## Power products in this section

- UPS: instant backup for computers, routers and CCTV, so you never lose work or connection
- Portable power stations: large rechargeable batteries with AC sockets for longer outages, trips and camping
- Extension boards: more sockets with surge protection and USB charging

## Choosing backup power

Add up the wattage of the devices you want to keep running and decide how long they need to run. A small UPS can keep a router running for hours, while a computer needs a larger unit. All power products we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: What is the difference between a UPS and an inverter?
faqs.answer: A UPS switches to battery almost instantly, which protects computers and routers from turning off. Home inverters power more appliances for longer but switch over more slowly.

faqs.question: How long will a UPS keep my router running?
faqs.answer: A router uses little power, so even a small UPS can keep it running for a long time. Runtime depends on the UPS battery capacity and the total load connected.

faqs.question: Do extension boards protect against power surges?
faqs.answer: Only models with built-in surge protection do. Look for surge protection on the product page if you plan to plug in TVs, computers or other expensive electronics.

seoDescription: Buy genuine UPS in Nepal for computers, Wi-Fi routers and CCTV: instant backup during power cuts and protection from fluctuations.
seoContent:
## Buy UPS in Nepal

A UPS (uninterruptible power supply) switches to battery the instant the power goes, so your computer does not shut off mid-work and your Wi-Fi stays connected through load shedding. It also smooths out voltage fluctuations that can damage electronics.

## Types of UPS

- Desktop UPS: for a computer and monitor, giving time to save work and shut down safely
- Mini UPS for routers: small DC units that keep your Wi-Fi router and ONT running for hours
- Online UPS: continuous protection for servers and sensitive equipment

## How to size a UPS

- Add up the wattage of everything you will connect
- Choose a UPS whose VA and watt ratings comfortably exceed that load
- Check the battery runtime at your load, not just the maximum rating
- Consider whether you need AVR (automatic voltage regulation) for areas with unstable voltage

All UPS units we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Which UPS do I need for my Wi-Fi router?
faqs.answer: A mini DC UPS made for routers is the most efficient choice. Check that its output voltage and connector match your router and ONT, often 9V or 12V.

faqs.question: What do VA and watts mean on a UPS?
faqs.answer: VA is the apparent power rating and watts is the real power it can deliver. Make sure the watt rating is higher than the total wattage of the devices you connect.

faqs.question: How long does a UPS battery last?
faqs.answer: UPS batteries typically need replacing every few years depending on use and temperature. Frequent power cuts and heat shorten battery life.

seoDescription: Shop portable power stations in Nepal: rechargeable batteries with AC sockets for load shedding, travel, camping and solar.
seoContent:
## Buy portable power stations in Nepal

A portable power station is a large rechargeable battery with AC sockets, USB-C and USB ports. It can power a laptop, router, lights, fan, TV or even small appliances during long power cuts, and goes with you on road trips and camping.

## How to choose a power station

- Capacity (Wh): how much energy it stores; more Wh means longer runtime
- Output (W): the maximum power it can supply at once; check it can handle your appliances
- Battery type: LiFePO4 batteries last for many more charge cycles
- Charging: wall, car and solar charging options; fast AC charging is convenient
- Ports: AC sockets, USB-C PD for laptops, USB-A and 12V outputs
- UPS function: some models switch over automatically during power cuts

To estimate runtime, divide the capacity in Wh by your devices' total watts, then allow for some conversion loss. All power stations we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: How long will a power station run my devices?
faqs.answer: Divide the capacity in watt-hours by the total watts of your devices, then allow roughly 15 percent for conversion losses. For example, a 500 Wh station running a 50 W load lasts a little over 8 hours.

faqs.question: Can I charge a power station with solar panels?
faqs.answer: Most power stations support solar charging through a compatible solar panel. Check the supported input voltage and wattage on the product page.

faqs.question: Can a power station run a refrigerator?
faqs.answer: Some can, if the continuous output and surge rating are higher than the fridge's requirements. Check your fridge's power rating and the station's output before buying.

seoDescription: Buy genuine extension boards in Nepal with surge protection, USB charging ports and multiple universal sockets.
seoContent:
## Buy extension boards in Nepal

Most rooms never have enough sockets in the right places. A good extension board adds safe sockets for computers, TVs, chargers and appliances, and the right one also protects them from voltage spikes.

## What to look for

- Surge protection: important for TVs, computers, routers and other expensive electronics
- Socket type: universal sockets accept most plug shapes used in Nepal
- USB ports: USB-A and USB-C charging ports free up sockets for other devices
- Load rating: check the maximum current or wattage before plugging in heaters and kettles
- Individual switches and an overload switch for safety
- Cable length that reaches where you need it

## Use it safely

Do not plug one extension board into another, and avoid running high-power appliances such as heaters and irons together on one board. All extension boards we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Can I plug a heater into an extension board?
faqs.answer: Only if the board's load rating is higher than the heater's wattage, and preferably with nothing else high-powered on the same board. Heaters are safest plugged directly into a wall socket.

faqs.question: Does an extension board protect against surges?
faqs.answer: Only boards with built-in surge protection do. They are recommended for TVs, computers and routers.

faqs.question: Do USB ports on an extension board fast-charge phones?
faqs.answer: It depends on the board. Models with USB-C Power Delivery can fast-charge; basic USB ports charge more slowly. The product page lists the USB output.

seoDescription: Buy Bluetooth trackers in Nepal to find keys, bags, wallets and luggage with your phone, including AirTag-style trackers.
seoContent:
## Buy Bluetooth trackers in Nepal

A Bluetooth tracker attaches to your keys, bag, wallet or luggage so you can find it with your phone. Ring it when it is somewhere in the house, or see its last known location on a map when it is further away.

## How trackers work

- Nearby: your phone connects over Bluetooth and plays a sound on the tracker
- Further away: trackers on a finding network, such as Apple Find My or Google Find My Device, can be located by other people's phones nearby, anonymously
- Separation alerts on some models warn you if you leave an item behind

## Choose the right tracker

- Phone compatibility: Apple Find My trackers work with iPhone; others work with Android or both
- Shape: key fobs, slim cards for wallets and stickers
- Battery: replaceable coin cells or rechargeable batteries
- Loudness of the speaker

All trackers we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Do Bluetooth trackers work in Nepal?
faqs.answer: Yes. Ringing a nearby tracker works anywhere. Long-distance location depends on the finding network having other compatible phones nearby, which is better in busy areas.

faqs.question: Will an AirTag work with Android?
faqs.answer: AirTags need an iPhone to set up and track. Android users should choose trackers that support Android's finding network or the brand's own app.

faqs.question: Can I use a tracker for my luggage when flying?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many travellers put a tracker in their checked bag to follow its location. Trackers use small coin cell batteries that are generally allowed.

seoDescription: Shop universal travel adapters in Nepal with USB-C fast charging, for travel abroad and devices with foreign plugs.
seoContent:
## Buy travel adapters in Nepal

Nepal mainly uses Type C, D and M sockets, while countries you travel to may use completely different ones. A universal travel adapter lets you charge your phone, laptop and camera almost anywhere, and also helps with devices bought abroad that have a foreign plug.

## What to look for

- Coverage: universal adapters work in most countries with UK, US, EU and AU style plugs
- USB charging: built-in USB-A and USB-C ports, ideally with fast charging, reduce the number of chargers you carry
- Surge and fuse protection for safety
- Compact, travel-friendly design

## Adapter or converter?

A travel adapter changes the plug shape, not the voltage. Nepal uses 230V, and most phone and laptop chargers accept 100 to 240V, but some appliances such as hair dryers may not. Check the voltage label on your device. All travel adapters we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Which plug type does Nepal use?
faqs.answer: Nepal mainly uses Type C, D and M sockets with a 230V, 50 Hz supply.

faqs.question: Does a travel adapter convert voltage?
faqs.answer: No. It only changes the plug shape. Most phone and laptop chargers work from 100 to 240V, so they only need an adapter, but check the label on other devices.

faqs.question: Can I charge a laptop through a travel adapter?
faqs.answer: Yes. Plug your laptop charger into the adapter, or use the adapter's USB-C port if it supports enough wattage for your laptop.

seoDescription: Buy screen and gadget cleaning kits in Nepal to safely clean phones, laptops, camera lenses, keyboards and earbuds.
seoContent:
## Buy cleaning kits in Nepal

Dust, fingerprints and grime build up quickly on screens, keyboards, earbuds and camera lenses, especially with the dust in Kathmandu. A proper cleaning kit removes it safely without scratching coatings or pushing dirt into ports.

## What a good cleaning kit includes

- A screen-safe cleaning spray
- Microfibre cloths that do not scratch
- Soft brushes for keyboards, vents and speaker grilles
- Cleaning pens or swabs for earbuds and charging ports
- A lens brush or blower for camera lenses

## Cleaning tips

Power off devices before cleaning, spray onto the cloth rather than directly onto screens, and never use harsh household cleaners on anti-glare or oleophobic coatings. All cleaning kits we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Is it safe to clean my laptop screen with spray?
faqs.answer: Yes, with a screen-safe cleaner sprayed onto a microfibre cloth, not directly onto the screen. Avoid household glass cleaners.

faqs.question: How do I clean my earbuds?
faqs.answer: Use a soft brush or cleaning pen to remove wax from the mesh, wipe the ear tips with a slightly damp cloth and let them dry fully before charging.

faqs.question: How often should I clean my keyboard?
faqs.answer: A quick brush every week or two keeps dust and crumbs from building up, with a deeper clean every few months.

seoDescription: Shop precision screwdriver and repair tool kits in Nepal for phones, laptops, consoles and electronics.
seoContent:
## Buy precision tool kits in Nepal

Modern gadgets use tiny, unusual screws that ordinary screwdrivers cannot open. A precision tool kit has the bits and tools to replace a laptop SSD, clean a console, fix glasses or repair small electronics yourself.

## What to look for

- Bit selection: Phillips, flathead, Torx, Pentalobe (for iPhones and MacBooks), Tri-wing and hex bits
- Magnetic driver and bit holder so screws do not get lost
- Opening tools, spudgers and suction cups for phones and tablets
- Anti-static tweezers for small parts
- A sturdy case that keeps bits organised

## Repair safely

Power off and unplug devices before opening them, take care around batteries and ribbon cables, and remember that opening some devices can affect their warranty. All tool kits we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Can I open an iPhone or MacBook with this kit?
faqs.answer: Kits that include Pentalobe bits can open the screws Apple uses on iPhones and MacBooks. Check the bit list on the product page.

faqs.question: Will opening my device void its warranty?
faqs.answer: It can, depending on the brand and device. Check the warranty terms before opening a device that is still covered.

faqs.question: Is a precision kit useful for PC builds?
faqs.answer: Yes. A precision kit handles small screws such as M.2 SSD screws, and the magnetic driver makes working inside a case easier.
